FROM node:24-bookworm-slim@sha256:55fb5f5a527ea2c5c4a95f963e48ef90aa38c7b346054fdc8ee9957a2b55d205
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev
COPY src ./src
USER node
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "src/server.js"]

codeConfigExcerpts.text:
- >-
          fetch('http://127.0.0.1:3000/health')
          .then(r => process.exit(r.ok ? 0 : 1))
          .catch(() => process.exit(1))
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 12s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 20s
    stop_grace_period: 15s

  inventory-consumer: &consumer
    build:
      context: .
    command: [node, src/consumer-server.js]
    environment: &consumer-env
      CONSUMER_ROLE: inventory
      KAFKA_BROKER: kafka:9092
      KAFKA_TOPIC: orders.events
      PROCESSING_DELAY_MS: "0"
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: on-failure
    healthcheck:
      test: [CMD, test, -f, /tmp/consumer-ready]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 6
      start_period: 20s
    stop_grace_period: 15s

  billing-consumer:
    <<: *consumer
    environment:
      <<: *consumer-env
      CONSUMER_ROLE: billing

  notification-consumer:
    <<: *consumer
    environment:
      <<: *consumer-env
      CONSUMER_ROLE: notification

volumes:
  kafka-data:
